categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai RAAS Blood Products Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the production and sales of blood products including human albumin, intravenous human immunoglobulin, specific immunoglobulins, and coagulation factor products. The company also operates through its wholly-owned subsidiary Tongluo Pharmaceutical, acting as the exclusive distributor in mainland China for imported human albumin and blood screening products from Grifols subsidiaries. It is one of the largest blood product manufacturers in China with a comprehensive product portfolio.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company uses biological and separation purification technologies to produce bioactive blood products from healthy human plasma. It employs advanced production quality management systems, including GMP compliance, automated production control systems (WINCC, WBS, WMS), and digitalized quality control. Continuous R&D efforts focus on improving plasma utilization rates, developing recombinant proteins, and expanding clinical indications, supported by collaborations with universities and research institutes.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are domestic hospitals and healthcare institutions across various regions in China, with sales also extending to overseas markets through authorized distributors. The company serves clinical needs in immunology, hematology, and emergency medicine, targeting patients requiring plasma-derived therapies such as immune deficiencies, bleeding disorders, and critical care. The top five customers account for about 20% of total sales, indicating a diversified customer base.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively across China with 44 plasma collection stations in 11 provinces including Guangxi, Hunan, Hainan, Shaanxi, Anhui, Guangdong, Inner Mongolia, Zhejiang, Hubei, Jiangxi, and Shandong. Its headquarters and main production facilities are located in Shanghai. It also has overseas operations and investments, notably holding a 45% stake in Grifols Diagnostic Solutions Inc. in the US and Europe, and engages in international distribution partnerships.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shanghai RAAS operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the blood products supply chain. It manages plasma collection stations (upstream raw material sourcing), plasma fractionation and product manufacturing (midstream), and sales and distribution to healthcare providers (downstream). The company also acts as an exclusive distributor for imported blood products, integrating upstream plasma resources with downstream clinical supply.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on expanding plasma resources through a dual approach of optimizing existing plasma stations and acquiring new ones, supported by digital and intelligent management systems. R&D priorities include innovation in coagulation factors, recombinant protein drugs for hemophilia, and expanding clinical indications. It emphasizes building a 'technology + market' ecosystem, enhancing marketing capabilities, and pursuing strategic mergers and acquisitions to strengthen its competitive position and product portfolio.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of self-produced blood products and imported products under exclusive distribution agreements. Sales channels include direct sales to hospitals, commissioned distributors, government procurement, and academic promotion. The company also earns income from investments and licensing, including dividends from equity investments in related companies like GDS.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Shanghai RAAS is one of the leading blood product manufacturers in China, with a comprehensive product range and high plasma utilization rate. It competes in a highly regulated industry with fewer than 30 domestic blood product producers. The company leverages strategic partnerships with global leaders like Grifols and benefits from strong marketing and clinical service capabilities. Industry consolidation and technological innovation are key competitive factors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported total operating revenue of approximately RMB 8.18 billion, a 2.67% increase from the previous year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 2.19 billion, up 23.4%. It maintains a strong asset base with total assets exceeding RMB 31.9 billion and continues to invest heavily in R&D (RMB 251 million, up 44%). The company’s plasma collection volume reached a record high of over 1,600 tons, supporting steady growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Shanghai RAAS emphasizes safety, quality, and efficiency as its core value proposition, positioning itself as a trusted health guardian with a broad and innovative product portfolio. It differentiates through advanced manufacturing technologies, comprehensive plasma resource management, and a strong clinical service network. The company’s integration of digitalization and intelligent systems enhances product quality and operational efficiency, while strategic partnerships and exclusive distribution rights strengthen its market leadership.
